children.innerHTML: Plot is a 4 KB charting library with opinions. One line of data in, one honest chart out. No config trees, no theme objects, three primitives and that's the point.
A NOTE FROM JUNE, WHO MADE THIS
Plot began the week I lost a whole afternoon to a chart config. Four hundred lines to draw six bars. Somewhere in there I stopped being a person who had data and became a person who had options.
I wanted charts the way I want writing: subject, verb, done. So Plot has three primitives, refuses to grow a fourth, and fits in an email attachment. Everything holds still; the data is the story.
Take your time below. Resize things.
Not screenshots. The real thing, drawn by your browser.

import plot from "@plot/charts"

plot.bars(revenue, { label: "Q3" })
“Deleted 900 lines of chart config. The chart looks better.”
“It's so small I read the whole source on the train.”
“My dashboard finally loads before my coffee order does.”
“The docs are shorter than most changelogs. Bliss.”
“Showed it to my team. Nobody argued. First time ever.”
